mapper.sql: s.deleted = FALSE AND s.status = 'ON_SHELF' AND p.deleted = FALSE AND p.status = 'ON_SHELF' AND c.deleted = FALSE AND c.status = 'ENABLED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM customer customer WHERE customer.id = #{customerId} AND customer.deleted = FALSE AND customer.status = 'COOPERATING' AND (customer.visibility_policy = 'ALL_ENABLED' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customer_sku_visibility visibility WHERE visibility.customer_id = customer.id AND visibility.sku_id = s.id AND visibility.deleted = FALSE)) )

s.id AS sku_id, p.id AS spu_id, p.category_id, c.name AS category_name, p.name AS product_name, s.sku_code, s.spec_name, s.sale_unit, s.product_type, (s.product_type = 'NON_STANDARD') AS non_standard, p.description, image.file_key AS primary_image_key, 'UNAVAILABLE' AS stock_status

FROM product_sku s JOIN product_spu p ON p.id = s.spu_id JOIN product_category c ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT i.file_key FROM product_image i WHERE i.spu_id = p.id AND i.deleted = FALSE AND i.is_primary = TRUE AND i.file_key LIKE 'public/%' ORDER BY i.id LIMIT 1 ) image ON TRUE
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE visible_category AS ( SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.parent_id, c.name, c.level, c.sort_order FROM product_category c WHERE c.deleted = FALSE AND c.status = 'ENABLED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM product_spu p JOIN product_sku s ON s.spu_id = p.id WHERE p.category_id = c.id AND ) UNION SELECT parent.id, parent.parent_id, parent.name, parent.level, parent.sort_order FROM product_category parent JOIN visible_category child ON child.parent_id = parent.id WHERE parent.deleted = FALSE AND parent.status = 'ENABLED' ) SELECT id AS category_id, parent_id, name, level, sort_order FROM visible_category ORDER BY level, sort_order, id

SELECT
WHERE
AND (p.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR s.sku_code ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(p.alias, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
AND p.category_id = #{query.categoryId} ORDER BY p.name, s.sort_order, s.id
